## What's new

- **Smooth camera tours.** Both tour styles, *Mind map* and *Free flight*, no longer stutter while the camera flies. Before, every change of zoom made Mindful redraw all letters at a new size, and cards flying close past the camera overflowed the font memory, which was then rebuilt in every frame. Text is now drawn at fixed sizes and scaled smoothly. In free flight, the slowest frames went from about 21 ms to about 1 ms. Zooming the mind map benefits too.

## Download

- `Mindful-macos-arm64.zip`: macOS 11 or newer on Apple silicon (M1 and newer)
- `Mindful-windows-x64.zip`: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit

**macOS:** Mindful isn't notarized by Apple yet. After the first launch attempt, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Alternatively, run:

```
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Mindful.app
```

**Windows:** unzip and start `Mindful.exe`. There is no installer. SmartScreen warns on the first start: click **More info → Run anyway**.
